name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Capture the lead, book the appointment, bring the customer back: that's the system I build for service businesses every day. My main GoHighLevel build is a 20+ workflow system covering lead capture and routing, booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and automated review requests. It's the same motion a med spa runs, and I like that a call with you is supposed to end with something fixed or built.

The parts of this role I'd step into fastest are the hands-on account work and the early warning. I troubleshoot workflows, integrations, and messaging myself, down to the webhook or JSON payload, I keep email deliverability above 99%, and I set up UTM and ad conversion tracking so attribution holds up in a success review. At Birdeye I managed 15-20 partners, including agencies serving healthcare clients, and kept all but one by watching utilization and stepping in before they disengaged.
I'd be learning medical aesthetics and the EMRs you connect to, and I pick up platforms quickly. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
